metadata.title: AI Productivity Recognition
metadata.summary: Recognized in organizational AI initiatives for sharing practical AI productivity approaches in engineering workflows.
metadata.embeddingText: Niraj was featured in organizational AI initiatives for sharing practical approaches to using AI tools for software engineering productivity, engineering efficiency, and delivery optimization.

metadata.title: ASP.NET Zero Open Source Contribution
metadata.summary: Contributed documentation improvements to the ASP.NET Zero ecosystem and received recognition from maintainers.
metadata.embeddingText: Niraj contributed documentation improvements to ASP.NET Zero built with ASP.NET Core, Angular, and Entity Framework Core and was recognized by maintainers for open source contributions.
